title: The Horus Heresy — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Behind The Horus Heresy sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. The Horus Heresy is a series of science fantasy novels set in the fictional Warhammer 40,000 setting of  tabletop miniatures wargame company Games Workshop. Penned by several authors, the series takes place during the Horus Heresy, a fictional galaxy-spanning civil war occurring in the 31st millennium, 10,000 years before the main setting of Warhammer 40,000.

The unconscious does not argue with The Horus Heresy; it simply acts first. Descent of Angels (Scanlon 2007) is a pre-Heresy story that concludes about 50 years before the start of that conflict. It introduces the "Dark Angels", first of the Space Marine Legions, and their Primarch Lion El'Jonson.
